run_convit_training: run the ConViT model training script on ImageNet with configurable epochs, batch size, and learning rate
run_convit_evaluation: run evaluation of a trained ConViT model on a validation dataset and report accuracy and throughput
run_convit_distributed_training: run distributed training of ConViT across multiple GPUs with RASampler and gradient clipping
run_convit_with_mixup: run ConViT training with mixup and cutmix augmentation enabled via configurable alpha and probability parameters
run_convit_resume_checkpoint: resume ConViT training from a saved checkpoint file including optimizer and scheduler state
